title: Side by Side
content: Here are two paintings by two friends, painting side by side from the same motif.On the left is Arthur Streeton and on the right is Charles Conder, two Australian impressionists who painted together during the magical summer of 1890 in Heidelberg, Australia.They chose a motif in full daylight, with the sun at their backs, and they both kept everything high-key, with the only dark accents under the log in the foreground.---------------Images courtesyArt Renewaland Wikipedia
